claude.rationale: gap_45=0: the contributed Sabine operating oil-and-gas organization (Sabine Holdings and its subsidiaries) crossed the boundary as a whole operating business combining with Forest's own oil and gas business, so the customer-facing operating assets moved together with their producing/delivering operations rather than as a product stripped of its processes. gap_56=0: the incoming Sabine management (Sambrooks, Levesque, et al.) and control functions (Deloitte, the Sabine-era auditor) were installed at the same December 16, 2014 closing that transferred the operating organization, so the operations and the people/management running them moved coherently together. sigma_T3 is coded continue because Forest remained the continuing public legal vehicle (renamed), and sigma_T6 swap reflects the wholesale removal of Forest officers/directors and installation of the Sabine team. Note: sigma_T3 label limited to enum options — coded 1-1 not available for T1; T3 continuity captured in rationale.

grok.rationale: The slice states that the contributed Sabine oil-and-gas operating organization became a wholly owned subsidiary of the continuing Forest registrant and combined with Forest's own oil and natural gas business, so customer-facing assets (T4) and operating processes (T5) crossed together at closing with no documented product-vs-process mismatch (gap_45=0). Concurrently at closing all Forest executive officers were removed and Sabine-appointed executives (CEO, COO, SVPs) plus a reconstituted board and Sabine's auditor were installed, so the people/management layer (T6) was aligned with the combined operations rather than left decoupled (gap_56=0).

openai.rationale: The contributed Sabine operating business, including Sabine Holdings and its subsidiaries, became a wholly owned subsidiary and combined with Forest's oil and natural gas business, so the customer-facing assets crossed together with the associated operating business rather than apart from it. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-14-375551, DEFM14A cover letter] The operating organization transferred alongside incoming executive management, while Forest's prior executive officers were removed at closing, documenting organizational alignment rather than a process-versus-people gap. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-14-450831, Form 8-K Item 5.02]
